description: Client-side script defining a custom report 'Supplier Quotation Comparison' in Frappe/ERPNext, including filters, formatting, and a dialog for setting default suppliers.

methods.name: formatter
methods.description: Formats specific columns in the report, highlighting 'valid_till' dates and 'price_per_unit' based on conditions.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Adds a button to the report page to open a dialog for setting default suppliers.

methods.name: make_default_supplier_dialog
methods.description: Creates and displays a dialog for selecting and setting a default supplier for an item.
